objective: Integrate the INS-006F quote-request submission identity contract into the existing D1 quote persistence owner without changing the HTTP ingress contract.

architecture.legacyWrite: createQuoteRequest remains supported unchanged at the public persistence interface
architecture.idempotentWrite: createIdempotentQuoteRequest performs lookup, replay/conflict resolution, and first-write batching
architecture.firstWriteAtomicity: relationship + submission ledger + acquisition + profile + consent + events remain inside one D1 batch
architecture.ledgerOrdering: relationship INSERT precedes submission ledger INSERT to satisfy the ledger foreign key
architecture.replay: existing key plus same fingerprint returns the stored relationship with zero write batch
architecture.conflict: existing key plus different fingerprint throws InsuranceQuoteRequestIdempotencyConflictError
architecture.concurrentCollision: batch failure triggers one ledger reread; same fingerprint becomes replay, different fingerprint becomes conflict, absent ledger propagates original failure
